hero.description: Fotografía editorial de la modelo vistiendo el Hanbok Moderno con jeogori negro, lazo de cintura y falda morada jacquard floral.

detalles.type: Detalle 1: Cuello Crossover & Vivo Rosa Pastel
detalles.description: Macro fotografía de alta costura al cuello cruzado del jeogori negro con vivo interior rosa pastel y costuras de alta sastrería.
detalles.prompt: Extreme macro close-up photography of the crossover collar neckline of the modern Hanbok from the reference image. Crisp clean black tailored cropped jeogori fabric with delicate light pastel pink inner collar lining accent. Fine high-density tailored stitching, matte black luxury fabric texture, studio rim lighting, shallow depth of field, haute couture craftsmanship detail, Andreart brand aesthetic.

detalles.type: Detalle 2: Lazo Otgoreum & Cinturón de Talle Alto
detalles.description: Plano detalle del lazo negro frontal y pretina ancha reposando sobre la textura de la falda brocada.
detalles.prompt: Macro close-up shot focusing on the wide black silk ribbon tie bow tied at the waist of the modern Hanbok from the reference image. The elegant black bow rests over the high-waisted pleated royal purple textured jacquard skirt with pale pink rose patterns. Clear focus on the smooth ribbon knot, the rich wavy textile texture underneath, clean stitching, luxury tailoring studio lighting.

detalles.type: Detalle 3: Pliegues Arquitectónicos & Acabados de Ruedo
detalles.description: Plano detalle a los pliegues de caída estructurada y las rosas en relieve sobre el tejido morado.
detalles.prompt: Close-up macro shot of the architectural pleats and hem of the royal purple jacquard flared skirt from the reference image. Embossed pale pink and lavender rose floral motifs across the textured wavy purple fabric. Deep crisp knife pleats, heavy fabric drape, invisible hem stitching, ultra-fine textile craftsmanship, elegant studio lighting.

patrones.type: Patrón 1: Muestra Textil Damasco / Jacquard Floral
patrones.description: Textura macro en plano cenital del tejido jacquard morado con rosas botánicas y ondas sutiles.
patrones.prompt: Full-frame macro flat lay photography of the luxury jacquard textile pattern from the skirt in the reference image. Rich royal purple woven fabric background with subtle wavy moire texture, adorned with delicate pale pink and soft lilac embossed botanical rose blossoms in full bloom. Intricate high-density thread weave, lustrous sheen, elegant haute couture textile swatch.

patrones.type: Patrón 2: Ficha Técnica CAD de Patronaje y Deconstrucción
patrones.description: Plano CAD vectorial con cotas técnicas, despiece de piezas y anotaciones de moldería adaptativa XS-XL.
patrones.prompt: Professional fashion technical flat drawing and CAD pattern blueprints for the modern Hanbok ensemble from the reference image. Pure crisp white background (#FFFFFF). On the left, a minimalist vector fashion figure wearing the black cropped jeogori and purple pleated floral skirt. On the right, geometric pattern cutting pieces (front jeogori crossover panel, collar band, pleated skirt draft) with fine black vector lines, tailoring dimension lines, pleat arrows, and neat uppercase technical callouts DESIGN NO. 043.
